forbidden_shortcuts: Do not change client encoding, suppress errors, or replace psql with a synthetic command

observable_symptom.command: printf 'SELEC 1;\n\\q\n' | PGCLIENTENCODING=WIN1252 LC_ALL=C PAGER=cat psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -h 127.0.0.1 -U postgres postgres

fail_to_pass.description: A real malformed SQL command no longer produces the encoding-conversion error and reports the SQL syntax error

pass_to_pass.description: A valid SQL query continues to execute successfully
